component.name: NAM Plug
component.summary: Neural Amp Modeler CLAP audio plugin

description.p: NAM-Plug is a high-performance Neural Amp Modeler audio plugin in CLAP (CLever Audio Plug-in) format, engineered in pure Rust with strict real-time safety.

ul.li: State-of-the-art neural emulation of guitar amplifiers, preamps, and pedals using WaveNet and LSTM topologies.
Hardware-accelerated SIMD AVX2/FMA vectorization with zero heap allocations on the audio thread.
Integrated CabSim Impulse Response (IR) loader and convolver.
Dual operational modes: Live (zero latency, adaptive compute) and HQ/Offline (4× oversampled linear-phase rendering).
Responsive hardware-accelerated OpenGL UI built with egui.
Extensive CLAP extension integration: Audio Ports, Latency, GUI, State, Track Info, and Tail.

description.p: NAM-Plug 0.5.0 release with Flatpak metadata and CLAP integration.

ul.li: CLAP plugin format support with egui GUI and headless capabilities.
WaveNet and LSTM neural model inference with SIMD AVX2 acceleration.
